isolation.question: Is our data separate from other companies'?
isolation.answer: Yes. Each company gets its own isolated data — nothing is ever shared or visible across companies.

migration.question: Do we have to move everything at once?
migration.answer: No. We'll work with you on a pace that fits your shop, starting with the projects you're actively running.

learningCurve.question: How long does it take to learn?
learningCurve.answer: Most teams are comfortable within their first few jobs — the workflow follows how you already work, not the other way around.

mobile.question: Does it work on a phone or tablet in the workshop?
mobile.answer: Yes, it works in a browser on any device — no separate app to install.

pricing.question: What does it cost?
pricing.answer: Pricing depends on your company's size and needs. Request a quote and we'll work it out with you.

arabic.question: Is it available in Arabic?
arabic.answer: Yes — the whole product is available in both Arabic and English.
